panels.title: How agents find their way in nixos-config (main sessions, last 24 h, hourly)
Navigation calls before the first edit
panels.description: Read, Grep, Glob and Bash lookups before the first Edit/Write of each prompt stretch that touched the repo, median and p90. Retro baseline (18 Nov): median 3, p90 11. Bad: p90 above about 15, or the median rising week over week: agents cannot find the place to change. A role with fewer than 50 repo navigation calls in the window has no point here (see Sample size).

panels.title: Top-level directories before the first edit
panels.description: Distinct top-level repo directories looked at before the first edit of a repo stretch, median and p90. Retro baseline: median 1, p90 4. Bad: p90 above about 6: one change needs touching many areas (scattered wiring). A role with fewer than 50 repo navigation calls in the window has no point here (see Sample size).

panels.title: Repo lookups that missed
panels.description: Share of repo navigation calls that errored, came back empty, found no match or no such file. Retro baseline: 3.6 %, daily 1.4 to 6.6 %. Bad: sustained above about 6 %: the paths and names agents expect are wrong or moved. Reads low: `|| true`, `2>/dev/null` and `; echo rc=$?` hide a failed grep. A role with fewer than 50 repo navigation calls in the window has no point here (see Sample size).

panels.title: Repeat reads of repo files
panels.description: Share of repo file reads (Read, cat, head, tail, sed -n) of a file the same session already read in the window. Retro baseline: 56 %, daily 49 to 66 %. Bad: creeping toward 70 % and above: files too big to hold, or context lost (compaction) and fetched again. It cannot tell a wasteful re-read from one after an edit. A role with fewer than 50 repo navigation calls in the window has no point here (see Sample size).

panels.title: Sample size
panels.description: Repo navigation calls with a result in the last 24 h, always written; repo stretches and repo file reads beside them when there are enough. Under 50 calls a role's ratios and quantiles are left out on purpose: a thin day is absent, not a swing.

panels.title: Collector: hours since the stalest section
panels.description: Per host. The timer runs hourly, so above about 2 h the collector is failing or the host was off (journalctl -u nav-metrics).

panels.title: Collector: sections failed in the last run
panels.description: Per host, out of 4 (scan, stretches, misses, rereads). Above 0: a section raised or the 240 s deadline passed; its series are left out until it succeeds.
